findings.passage: The Texas House is hearing legislation on election integrity today. Upholding election integrity is one of the key priorities that Texans have demanded we get done. We must preserve our democracy by making it easy to vote and hard to cheat. #ElectionIntegrity
findings.note: Post on his campaign site, written while he served in the Texas House, calling election integrity a priority.

findings.passage: Election Integrity is almost ready to become the law in Texas. With the passage of Senate Bill 1 in both the House and Senate, we will protect the right of every citizen to cast a secure ballot and make it easy to vote, and hard to cheat, preserving our democracy. #txlege
findings.note: Campaign-site post on passage of SB 1 (2021 election law) in both chambers.

findings.passage: Today was a very full and consequential day and night for the Texas House. We passed the historic election integrity bill on third reading, and it’s heading to the Senate for a conference committee report.
findings.note: Campaign-site post about House third-reading passage of the 2021 election integrity bill (SB 1, second called session).
